# LL-P16 one-round evaluation rules

## Inputs and execution

The paired unit is one of 60 items. Each item has one scheduled turn in each arm. The 48 answerable items comprise 10 definition/fact, 10 explanation, 10 procedure/worked example, 9 comparison and 9 cross-segment items. The 12 required refusals comprise 6 near-topic and 6 omitted-detail items. Six licensed indexed lectures belong to two courses disjoint from the older evaluation by canonical course ID. Independent reviewers clear the exact packet, gold and support bytes. The material receipt binds source/exclusion manifests, the six exact published Evidence snapshots and their aggregate, ordered fragments and vector index, the embedding model and import identity.

A uses the exact Light Tutor retrieval module from ef6fcd2b9fc566df92cb7f98fc98de561e911737. B uses 7964a2482e17f84e0373df7afc7c8179450dbc0c, the combined base after #87/#88. The pins share the runtime, scope authorization and product text policy. Both arms use the same ordered material, same question bytes, fresh one-turn non-Socratic sessions, isolated neutral PostgreSQL schemas and the same inference settings. Arm routing uses the pinned retrieval implementation in the pinned product prepare path. Synthetic parity covers both one-query and multi-query inputs and signed retrieval and READ boundaries.

Before any query, verify the authorized open public freeze PR, exact head SHA and blob SHA, SHA-256 of the freeze bytes, build, rule, material and independently cleared input digests. Recheck each stage. Hash approved or existing sealed files byte for byte, including any terminal LF. Derived hashes use UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON with no terminal newline, no ASCII escaping and no non-finite numbers. Persisted harness JSON uses the same serialization plus one terminal LF. The freeze binds the full versioned rules, executable contract, PR-independent schedule and audit designs and their private selection SHA-256 values. It records aggregate scope facts and hashes.

The frozen input adapter version is `ll-p16-v2-support-anchors-v2`. It joins the original cleared files by item ID after checking their exact byte hashes and leaves those files untouched. Each vital nugget retains its authored alternative support sets and every conjunction within them. Only IDs for retrievable rows in the item's sealed lecture may support an answer. For the shared blind grading gold, walk the alternatives and the IDs within them in authored order. Include each distinct ID's exact snapshot `normalizedText` once per vital nugget at its first occurrence. These strings are caption anchors for both arms. The adapter validates optional support mappings for shape and retrievable scope, then discards them. Optional nuggets have an empty anchor list. Missing or blank mapped vital anchor text fails validation. The adapter does not infer, shorten or look up more anchors. Anchor text is used in blind grading, while coverage uses the original vital alternatives and conjunctions.

Required-refusal rows have no coverage groups or caption anchors. The cleared packet's structured `required_refusal` must designate `selected_lecture` and have both Boolean flags true for declaring insufficient Evidence and withholding unsupported requested detail. These checks confirm the fixed rules and preserve the exact authored rationale in the L4 refusal rubric. Related in-scope IDs are checked against the sealed snapshot for membership and discarded. The author's `review_only_out_of_scope` field is excluded from all projected data, including Tutor, scoring and blind grading.

Schedule items by lexicographically sorted private IDs shuffled with Python Random seed 161704. Advance the same RNG one getrandbits(1) per shuffled item to pick arm order within its pair. Traverse pairs in that order in offline and Tutor phases. Start one offline product prepare for each arm/item. Use only the prepared local index with local embedding, signed Java Evidence authority and the current pinned snapshot. Save the ordered, deduplicated authoritative Evidence rows, exact sent-message hash and scope/index identity. Reuse that prepared state for the paid stage through the same product turn runtime and verify its frozen scope, live index head, unchanged authoritative READ and actual generated wire hash. No second retrieval. If offline preparation fails or is interrupted, record a failed context and omit Tutor generation for that slot. Tampering, scope or material discrepancies stop the stage.

A prepared empty Evidence list takes the pinned runtime's deterministic insufficiency branch. It creates one product turn, uses no Flash Tutor wire slot or charge, and can enter the blind judge as a delivered refusal. A nonempty context permits one Tutor send. An interrupted marked turn and a reserved-but-uncertain dispatch both remain as observed. Keep failed and missing slots and never repeat an attempted Tutor turn. After infrastructure interruption, resume only previously unattempted slots under the same freeze and an active coordinator authorization. Sealing the report and its blind packet closes execution, including when the coordinator accepts a partial round. No second evaluation round or result-dependent changes.

## Metrics

Strict correct is count of delivered answers on the 48 answerable slots per arm with valid Flash v1 judgment, every vital nugget supported and no material error. Refusal accuracy is count of delivered declared insufficiency on the 12 required-refusal slots per arm with a valid readable judgment, no unsupported teaching and no material error. Failed, absent, invalid and unreadable outcomes score zero; an answerable-item refusal and a required-refusal-item answer score zero. Accompany accuracy with complete delivery, failure-code, judge-status and generation-state counts over scheduled slots. Material-error rate uses successfully delivered and assessed answers on answerable slots. Report assessed numerator/denominator, unassessed delivered answers, and extreme rates obtained by scoring every unassessed delivered answer as clean or as materially erroneous. A missing denominator is null.

For answerable items, count a vital nugget covered when the ordered authoritative context contains every fragment in at least one of its independently cleared alternative support sets. Report complete coverage over answerable items and micro coverage over their vital nuggets. Report context bytes as the size of the canonical UTF-8 array of ordered authoritative deduplicated rows actually prepared for Tutor, including the row metadata. Use the prepared array whether or not subsequent generation succeeds. Empty or failed/missing retrieval is the canonical empty array (2 bytes and zero vital hits). Report context mean and nearest-rank P95 overall, for answerable and refusal splits, and by each of the seven item types, including comparisons and cross-segment. Report counts of each context status.

Report B minus A for each defined comparable metric. The paired 95% percentile interval uses 10,000 bootstrap draws, Python Random seed 161707 reset for each reporting population. Within each lexicographically ordered course-by-type stratum draw the observed stratum size with replacement from sorted item IDs and keep both responses together. Recalculate metrics, their denominators and context quantiles within each draw. Use the 2.5th and 97.5th nearest-rank percentiles, ceil(p times count), over defined differences and report defined draw counts. Effects apply to sampled course releases.

## Blind grading and audit

Generate opaque L4 response IDs and presentation order from a private random 32-byte seed with a public SHA-256 commitment. Store the neutral-to-arm key privately outside the review directory. The judge gets the question, language, gold, normalized answer, declared insufficiency and canonical cited excerpts renumbered by L4. It gets no arm, comparative result, timing or ledger data. Its prompt and validator are the exact l4-flash-judge-v1 at B. Failed and missing delivery slots are scored directly without a judge send. Save wire bytes privately before interpreting them.

Transport errors, non-200 responses, unknown usage, identity or fingerprint changes and capacity errors stop the paid phase and retain any unresolved reservations. They are not eligible for a judge retry. One byte-identical retry is allowed only for an initial HTTP 200 with verified usage and identity whose response framing or Flash v1 judgment cannot be validated. A valid unreadable result earns zero and has no retry. A second invalid result earns zero. First and second invalids and interrupted dispositions remain distinct in the private ledger.

Audit 15 question pairs (30 responses). Stratify by course and type before grading and use Python Random seed 161705. Assign one per nonempty stratum when the number of strata fits. Proportionally allocate remaining slots to remaining capacity by floor and descending integer remainder with ties by course and type. With more than 15 strata, apply the same proportional rule from zero. Sample without replacement from sorted IDs in sorted strata. Record absent strata, each stratum's population and sample size, and inclusion probability m/N. The blind packet keeps the sampled scheduled responses including failed, invalid, unreadable, interrupted and missing cases. It contains delivery state, citations and rubric inputs, while grader outcome, attempt, neutral-to-arm key and aggregate scores stay private. Failure or missing delivery is a deterministic false endpoint. For delivered cases the human grades independently of judge status and can mark a genuinely undetermined endpoint null. Verify the independently signed audit receipt against the exact packet hash and all response IDs before unblinding results.

For strict and refusal endpoints separately, show per-arm matched comparable denominators, undetermined count, binary agreement, Cohen's kappa when defined, false acceptances, false rejections and their difference as a count and divided by comparable n. Binary automatic failure on every ungraded or invalid slot uses the same zero as the automatic endpoint. Automatic totals remain intact. Add the stratified Horvitz–Thompson mean human-minus-automatic correction, weighting each sampled delta by N/m and dividing by the endpoint population. Report its adjusted arm estimates and their paired B minus A without clipping; reconstruct the paired difference from the same sampled pairs. Publish the adjusted endpoint only if each relevant stratum is represented and all its sampled endpoints are determined in both arms. Otherwise report unavailable, with coverage. Treat agreement, bias and correction as small-sample estimates.

## Spend and stop rules

Use the official HTTPS Chat Completions endpoint and deepseek-flash (published release DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017), with thinking disabled, no streaming, no external provider, tools or auxiliary prompts. Use the pinned Tutor and Flash judge output cap of 4,096 tokens in both paths. Verify the route, current terms, direct CNY balance and price window before paid dispatch. Bind the first verified response's backend fingerprint as the observed version receipt. Stop if it changes. Balance checks use the account endpoint and send no model prompt.

The hard ceiling is CNY 10. With no prompt cache discount, capped off-peak reservations are CNY 0.026384 per Tutor slot and CNY 0.028384 per judge slot. Maximums are 120 Tutor wire reservations, 120 initial judge reservations, and 120 conditional judge retries. The declared conservative sum at those caps is CNY 9.97824 off-peak and CNY 19.95648 peak, so paid dispatch is restricted to off-peak. Weekday peak intervals are 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC. The harness conservatively treats holidays as normal weekdays. It checks entry and a 180-second window around each dispatch, with at most 90 seconds for the wire request. It starts one wire round trip at a time with at least 2 seconds between starts.

Before sending, render the request with the released Flash-1017 text-only non-thinking prompt framing and tokenizer. Add 512 tokens as an allowance for API framing. Refuse any request estimate above the fixed 10,000 Tutor or 12,000 judge prompt-token admission ceiling. Precheck all ready Tutor requests after offline capture and all eligible judge requests before grading. These are spending admission ceilings and preserve the pinned content intact. The provider reports actual usage and may add server-side framing. Check actual usage against the class reservation; an overrun triggers immediate paid stop and its reported usage goes into the ledger.

Before dispatch, commit a unique, synchronous SQLite reservation for the full class maximum at uncached off-peak prices. Require settled charges plus unresolved reservations plus the next reservation to fit under CNY 10, and require sufficient current CNY balance for unresolved charges and the remaining declared worst case. Price cache-hit inputs, cache-miss inputs and completion tokens separately using the official tier and recorded usage. Preserve full private wire bytes and hashes before decode unless they contain the credential, in which case retain the unresolved reservation and a redacted stop. Missing or inconsistent usage retains the reservation at its full upper bound. No hidden retries or parallel paid commands. Stop and report the redacted reason, settled amount, unresolved amount and remaining bound when funds, identity, capacity, admission, declared counts, data or authorization cannot be verified. Keep per-case results private and publish results only after the independent blind audit receipt is pinned.

Pricing and identity sources: DeepSeek CNY Models & Pricing, Chat Completions, Thinking Mode, Get User Balance, and the official Flash-1017 release and tokenizer. Off-peak rates in CNY per million are 0.02 cache hit, 1 cache miss and 4 output. Peak rates are 0.04, 2 and 8.
